criteria.criterion: `jira_dc_pat` is `scope="session"`, verified by reading the fixture declaration, so a run mints exactly ONE PAT no matter how many tests request it

citation.description: Ticket comment records GitHub Actions run 30651750699, job 'jira DC harness smoke (real Jira Data Center, ephemeral)', on merged commit 132a0f9dc: '1 failed, 14 passed in 15.67s — and ZERO UserTokenLimitExceededException.' The codebase fix (session scope at conftest.py:432) is the structural mechanism that prevents the exception.

criteria.criterion: the full `tests/external/live_jira_dc` suite runs in the GitHub Actions `jira DC harness smoke` job with ZERO `UserTokenLimitExceededException`, confirmed by reading that job's log — not the overall run status
headroom is structural, not coincidental: because consumption is O(1) in test count, the run above passes with MORE live tests present than the count that first triggered the cap
a leftover `rebar-j5-harness-*` token from a crashed run is deleted at session start, so it does not break the next run — covered by a unit test against a stubbed `_request`
the sweep never deletes a token lacking the `rebar-j5-harness-` prefix, asserted by unit test
the sweep degrades safely: a non-200/non-list list response yields an empty result rather than an exception, and a failed DELETE does not abort the session — both unit-tested
the 10-token cap and the session-scope decision are documented in the `jira_dc_pat` docstring, since the cap is a non-obvious Jira DC limit
